sentences.text:
Opposite Party
 ---
 Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rongon Mukhopadhyay

---
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Nilesh Kumar, Advocate

For the Opposite Party : Mr. P. D. Agrawal, Special P.P.
---
3/24.08.2020 Heard the parties.
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Chowka P.S. Case No. 20 of 2020.

It has been alleged that on 04.05.2020, the grocery shop of the petitioner was inspected and in the packet of Lal Ghora Special Sattu, neither the batch number nor the date of manufacture was mentioned.
It appears to be a case of misbranding.
The petitioner is the owner of the grocery shop.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the provision of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act has already been repealed and the allegations which have been made is guided by Food Safety and Standard Act only.
Mr. P. D. Agrawal, learned Special P. P. has opposed the prayer.
In view of the nature of allegations and the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the petitioner, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner above named is directed to surrender in the court below within four weeks and pray for bail, and in that event, he shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.
10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Seraikella in connection with Chowka P.S. Case No. 20 of 2020, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
